c1.note: The release and 10-K both show FY26 enterprise revenue of $41,691M, the latest full fiscal year as of 2026-11-11.

c2.note: FY26 ended Jan 31, 2026 is the most recent completed fiscal year; FY27 ends around Jan 2027 and has not been reported.

c3.note: FY25 revenue was $41,528M per the release's comparison column.

c4.note: FY24 revenue of $43,452M matches my knowledge of the 10-K; the saved passages do not show it directly.

c6.note: 43,452 versus 41,528 is -4.4%, and 46,298 versus 43,452 is -6.1%; FY24 and FY23 figures are from my knowledge.

c7.note: The release gives +0.5% for FY26 and -2.3% for FY25; the -6.8% for FY24 matches my knowledge.

c8.note: Domestic revenue was 38,278 in FY26 versus 38,238 in FY25.

c9.note: International revenue was 3,413 in FY26 versus 3,290 in FY25.

c11.note: Q4 Domestic was 12,575 versus 12,715 and International 1,239 versus 1,233.

c12.note: Revenue fell in FY23, FY24 and FY25 (51.8B to 46.3B to 43.5B to 41.5B), then rose slightly in FY26; FY23 is from my knowledge.

c13.note: The March 2026 guidance is $41.2B-$42.1B, but it may have been updated in later quarterly reports; none were in the evidence.

c15.note: The auditor's report is dated March 18, 2026, so the 10-K was filed on or after March 18, not around March 16.

c16.note: The auditor's report is dated March 18, 2026, and credit ratings are stated as of March 16, which is consistent with a 10-K filed on March 18, though no passage states the filing date explicitly.

c17.note: FY26 ended January 31, 2026 and FY25 ended February 1, 2025, so the fiscal year does not match the calendar year.

c18.note: The Q4 release shows FY26 Enterprise revenue of $41,691M for the 52 weeks ended January 31, 2026 (FY25: $41,528M), which is the completed fiscal-year total and not a TTM figure or forecast.

c19.note: Best Buy typically reports Q3 in the last week of November (around Nov 25-26), so Q3 FY27 results are expected after today's date. No passage gives the date, and the FY27 guidance of $41.2-42.1bn supports the 'may differ slightly' caveat.

c7.note: The FY2026 10-K (bby-20260131) reports comparable sales of +0.5% for FY2026, -2.3% for FY2025 and -6.8% for FY2024. These match the claim. The 10-K applies one method to all three years.
